ValidationRule.description: New reviews start Pending, carry a verdict, file version and model, and have no decision stamp.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISNEW(), OR( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Decision__c, "Pending")), ISBLANK(TEXT(Verdict__c)), ISBLANK(Content_Version_Id__c), ISBLANK(Model__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Decided_By__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Decided_On__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A new review must be Pending, include a verdict, file version and model, and have no decision recorded.
